note: Written by `sh scripts/ops/verified-build.sh --local --write` (or --docker --write on a Linux host with Docker). The hash is solana-verify's executable hash: sha256 of the program bytes with trailing zero bytes removed — the same number `solana-verify get-program-hash` prints for the deployed program and `solana-verify get-executable-hash` prints for a .so. docs/burnticker/VERIFIED-BUILD.md renders this table; test/burntickerVerifiedBuild.test.ts holds the two together and compares any built .so on the host.
kindNote: INTERIM: built with cargo build-sbf on the operator's Mac (no Docker on that host), not inside solana-verify's Docker image. These hashes are reproducible on that toolchain (a clean build in a fresh checkout gave the same bytes) and the devnet ones equal the bytes deployed on devnet, read back from chain. A Docker build on Linux may give different numbers; when it runs, it replaces this table (kind: docker) and the Docker numbers become the ones to check.
sourceCommitNote: The last monorepo commit that changed the compiled program sources: end-sink round 4 with the pair-forward round-3 re-check fixes (2026-10-12). Both programs were upgraded to these bytes on devnet and mainnet through the Squads vaults on 2026-10-12 (docs/burnkeeper/evidence/devnet-round4, docs/burnkeeper/evidence/mainnet-round4).
